_comment: Codex runtime hooks (Phase 2.4, issue #361). Parallel to hooks/hooks.json (Claude). Event names use the neutral form; lib/runtime_adapters/hooks.py maps them to Codex-native names at runtime. Worktree-guard + git-guard are wired here so Codex's before_tool_use events hit the same enforcement layer as Claude Code's PreToolUse events.

hooks.command: for i in python3 python py; do if "$i" -c "" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$i" tools/save_log.py --tool codex; exit 0; fi; done
